item: Matchup implied for 'LA Clippers', 'Chicago Bulls', 'Miami Heat' rows

item: Records are as displayed at retrieval
detail: Team records on the NBA.com games page are shown without a per-row timestamp. They reflect the time of retrieval, not a fixed as-of date. 11/14 and 11/15 games: records blank where not displayed.

item: Odds toggle present but no odds values captured
detail: The NBA.com games page includes a 'HIDE ODDS' control. Odds values were not extracted and the odds provider is not identified on the page. No odds are used anywhere in this project.
The URL official.nba.com/nba-injury-report-2025-26-season/ redirected to the 2026-27 page. The 2026-27 page is the one cited.

Ksa states that only operators with a Koa licence (art. 31a Wet op de kansspelen) may offer online sports wagers in NL. Whether publishing lines, picks, or a prize leaderboard counts as offering wagers is NOT determined here and needs a qualified legal review.
Ksa's home page links to a list of granted licences ('Verleende vergunningen'). That list was not retrieved, so no operator is verified.

The games page lists teams in an order and the injury report uses 'AWAY@HOME' codes (e.g., MIL@ORL). The table treats the first-listed team as away. This matches the injury-report codes where both are printed, but it was not confirmed on a separate official page.
